!Second Phase
`25% Chance to receive ~50 Shield` at the start of each turn.

Damage is applied in two phases: 50% at the start of the round and the remaining 50% at the end.
The Player Team always attacks first.

Healing is applied after both sides have each dealt 50% of their damage. 
It does not carry over between turns.

Shield blocks incoming damage up to its value. 
It persists between turns but resets at the start of a new enemy encounter.
